Sandstorm Quirk.name: Sandstorm Quirk
Sandstorm Quirk.description:
🌪️ Grit lifts at your heels and follows a sweep of your hands. A handful can screen a doorway. A sandpit gives you a whole playground.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Earth and Wind: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you can push a ribbon of grit five meters or pack a low step from the sand underfoot.
📈 With training: a scouring vortex, a dust devil that carries grit out of a rescue lane, and a translucent sand-glass wall.
⚠️ You need loose mineral grains. Rain clumps them, crosswinds spoil your aim, and a bare steel floor gives you nothing to lift.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Visible Tell. If chosen, a little halo of dust circles your ankles before a cast.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Pixie-Bob (Earth Flow) and Inasa Yoarashi (Whirlwind).

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Search and Rescue +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Pocket Sirocco, Footprint Step
Sandstorm Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: Ground contact gathers nearby grains. A first gust drives them five meters, or packs one step beneath a foot. Training can shape a short lane. Limits: Bring grit to a bare floor. Wet sand packs but barely flies. Crosswinds spread a screen across both teams. Fixed rock and bedrock stay put. Quirk Strain: light: Pocket Sirocco, Footprint Step; moderate: Blindside Drift, Ballast Bench, Grit Pennant; heavy: Spiral Scour, Landing Bar, Pit Crew Devil, Slipface Rush, Bunker Bowl; severe: Dune Window. Fusion: Earth and Wind at about half solo reach and force. Together they sustain a scouring vortex, a grit-carrying dust devil, or a pressure-set sand-glass wall. Type: Emitter. Law: Blowing grit across traffic can cause a pileup. Look: Low spirals stripe the air in the colors of local sand.
